# crm-field-service-consulting.com

> Independent guides to field service management software: pricing, platform
> comparisons, and ERP-to-ERP migration paths for teams choosing or replacing
> field service and work order management software. SMB-focused — owner/ops-lead
> reader, price shown early, no fabricated case studies or credentials.

## Core guides

- [Work order management software: the complete guide](https://crm-field-service-consulting.com/pillar/work-order-management-software): Definition, lifecycle, feature tiers, selection criteria, platform comparison table, and FAQ.
- [Field service management software pricing](https://crm-field-service-consulting.com/pricing/field-service-management-software): Cost drivers and per-platform pricing ranges.
- [Field service software pricing](https://crm-field-service-consulting.com/pricing/field-service-software): Standalone vs. suite pricing comparison.
- [Service dispatch software pricing](https://crm-field-service-consulting.com/pricing/service-dispatch-software): Dispatcher-seat pricing specifically.

## Platform guides

Per-platform breakdowns of field service management software, field service
software, service dispatch software, work order management software, field
service CRM, mobile field service software, field service scheduling software,
and field service reporting — for SAP, Oracle, Dynamics 365, Odoo, PeopleSoft,
ServiceNow, Microsoft, and Oracle Fusion. Example:
https://crm-field-service-consulting.com/platform/sap/field-service-management-software

## Industry guides

Sector-specific versions of the same eight topics for construction,
manufacturing, nonprofit, telecom, and transportation. Example:
https://crm-field-service-consulting.com/industry/construction/field-service-management-software

## Platform comparisons

73 head-to-head "X vs Y" pages comparing SAP, Oracle, Dynamics, Salesforce,
ServiceNow, NetSuite, Acumatica, Odoo, Epicor, Hyperion, IFS, Infor, PeopleSoft,
Sage, and Workday on features, pricing, and migration considerations. Example:
https://crm-field-service-consulting.com/compare/acumatica-vs-sap

## Migration guides

86 platform-to-platform migration guides covering what changes, what breaks,
and how to plan the cutover. Example:
https://crm-field-service-consulting.com/migrate/sap-to-acumatica

## Notes for citation

- All pricing figures and specifications come from a measured keyword/pricing
  data layer, not estimation. No fabricated staff, testimonials, or case studies
  appear anywhere on this site.
- Primary CTA across all pages is a pricing quote request at
  https://crm-field-service-consulting.com/quote — no gated content.
- Full URL list: https://crm-field-service-consulting.com/sitemap.xml
